messages.subject: ordered cut points --- need to truncate hierarchical prior?
parts:
If we have a parameter

ordered[K] c[J];

with J different cutpoints, then our recommendations suggest
partial pooling with a hierarchical model:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/wiki/Prior-Choice-Recommendations

But if we do that, won't we need to include the truncations
because of the ordering constraints? I don't think they'll
drop out. I'm afraid I don't have time to work out what we
need, but if someone could add a note to the wiki above,
that'd be super helpful.

This came up in a query from Antonio Martini in post
titled "Multilevel Ordered Logistic Regression", but I thought
I'd highlight my question.

Thanks,

- Bob
